channel.title: Forza Horizon 6 Guide — Horizon Japan
channel.description: Forza Horizon 6 lands in a fictionalised Japan with the biggest map the series has ever built — 636 cars in the live roster today (550+ at launch). This guide covers the car list, Car Pass and DLC packs, barn finds, treasure cars, the Estate, the interactive Japan map, and a beginner path to Horizon Legend — with sources noted for everything.

item.title: Festival Playlist Tracker — Series 4 "Horizon Mascot Party" rewards & Car Pass drops
item.description: Live now — Series 4 "Horizon Mascot Party", August 13, 2026 to September 10, 2026. Winter (Aug 27 – Sep 3): 1974 Toyota Celica GT at 20 pts, 1989 Toyota MR2 SC at 40 pts. Series rewards: 1970 Honda N600 at 80 pts, 1967 Renault 8 Gordini at 160 pts. Car Pass drops: 1987 Porsche #203 Porsche AG 961 (Aug 13), 1957 Ford Thunderbird (Aug 20), 1968 Alfa Romeo Tipo 33/2 (Aug 27), 1983 Nissan Skyline 2000 Turbo (Sep 3). Data as of August 31, 2026; next season reset September 3, 2026 (Spring season, final week of Series 4).

item.title: Cars — list, best picks, aftermarket, Forza Edition, treasure & barn finds
item.description: Forza Horizon 6 now has 636 cars in the live roster (Aug 13, 2026) [WIKI], up from 550+ at launch. The first group is confirmed by Wikipedia; later groups are community-sourced (IGN, GamesRadar, Reddit) and clearly tagged. Three more — Japanese icons, hypercars & track toys, and muscle & super-saloons — come straight from the official forza.net roster table with real PI and class figures [Official]. This is a curated slice, not a 640+ database; see the source links on the cars hub.

item.title: Houses & Property — plus the interactive garage map & tracker
item.description: Two different sets of "8" trip up most FH6 property guides. Wikipedia confirms one headline property — The Estate — plus 8 Garages that double as fast-travel and car-display points [WIKI]. Separately, community guides list 8 buyable houses, each with a permanent perk; Wikipedia does not enumerate those, so they are tagged community-sourced [RPS, TECH, FH6GUIDE]. The Estate (Yashiki House) is the buildable headline plot. Houses unlock via the seven Discover Japan stamp tiers (Visitor to Master Explorer).
